name: 48214 · Detroit, MI
findings: ZIP 48214 (Detroit) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48214 (Detroit) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48214 (Detroit) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
